body_markdown:
Join eFax® in Philadelphia for the LeadingAge Annual Meeting, the premier national gathering for senior living and aging services providers. As long-term care organizations adopt new technology to meet shifting regulatory demands, we’re proud to share how digital fax innovation simplifies record management across senior care settings.


Connect with our experts to discover how eFax® streamlines resident intake, prior authorization and care coordination. Our intelligent document transformation tools turn unstructured documents into secure, actionable data streams ensuring vital patient records flow seamlessly across networks while safeguarding patient privacy.


[Learn More](https://annualmeeting.leadingage.org/)
